execution_policy: Use wrappers in independent subprocesses. Existing complete outputs are immutable. No raw preprocessing, model loading or training was run during migration.
order: For an existing paper cache: prepare with --se-embeddings; then gene-assets for fold_0. No SE regeneration is needed.

Only for rebuilding the historical all-cell SE cache: prepare-se with the explicit historical 201/25 condition manifest; encode each shard with bf16; merge. This cache producer split is not the final 189/37 additive evaluation split.
prepare uses official additive split (101 single +88 double train /37 double test), exact control seed4242, train-only baseHVG2000 union101 targets.
gene-assets uses the final additive fold control IDs and frozen train-control mean(lognormalized X); expm1 is only the tokenizer interface conversion.

Output flag checks follow argparse last-value semantics for repeated --flag VALUE and --flag=VALUE arguments.
Expose --target-se-only in gene-assets help; preserve the existing subprocess and immutable-output safeguards.
